summary: Plan all five retained layers of Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology, over a general nonarchimedean local field E in either characteristic. Every stage has a target-level plan; supplier refinements and a source proof gate keep the packet from being closed. No implementation is claimed.
